mechanism_narrative: Persistently low federal funds rate (below 0.5%) signals accommodative monetary policy that compresses discount rates for equity valuation, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate sustained economic stimulus.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5% (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return > 0).

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 7.0% signals labor market weakness that triggers central bank policy easing and increased risk appetite, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 7.0% (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return > 0).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicates a supply-side shock that reduces corporate profitability expectations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in INDPRO and PAYEMS fails to predict negative returns in more than 60% of cases (Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling window).

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime with housing starts (HOUST) above 900,000 units, consumer confidence and spending momentum support equity valuations, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST > 900 (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return > 0).

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts (HOUST) falling below 850,000 units signals weakening housing market conditions that reduce consumer confidence and corporate investment, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when HOUST < 850 (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return < 0).

mechanism_narrative: Sustained growth in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) above 150,000 thousand persons indicates strong labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS > 150,000 (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return > 0).

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) declining below 99.0 indicates manufacturing contraction that reduces corporate earnings expectations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO < 99.0 (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return < 0).

mechanism_narrative: High consumer spending regime (RSAFS > 400,000 million dollars) supports corporate revenue growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as retail sales momentum persists.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when RSAFS > 400,000 (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return > 0).
